verses.original: תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֜ר בְּצִיּ֗וֹן וְהָרִ֙יעוּ֙ בְּהַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֔י יִרְגְּז֕וּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־ בָ֥א יוֹם־ יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֥י קָרֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: tiq·‘ū šō·w·p̄ār bə·ṣî·yō·wn wə·hā·rî·‘ū bə·har qāḏ·šî yir·gə·zū kōl yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ kî- ḇā yō·wm- Yah·weh kî qā·rō·wḇ
verses.literal: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion sound the alarm on My holy mountain Let all who dwell in the land tremble for the Day of the LORD is coming indeed it is near
verses.literalPt: TOCAI a trombeta em Sião, e clamai em alta voz no meu santo monte; tremam todos os moradores da terra, porque o dia do SENHOR vem, já está perto;

verses.original: י֧וֹם חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וַאֲפֵלָ֗ה י֤וֹם עָנָן֙ וַעֲרָפֶ֔ל כְּשַׁ֖חַר פָּרֻ֣שׂ עַל־ הֶֽהָרִ֑ים עַ֚ם רַ֣ב וְעָצ֔וּם כָּמֹ֗הוּ לֹ֤א נִֽהְיָה֙ מִן־ הָ֣עוֹלָ֔ם וְאַֽחֲרָיו֙ לֹ֣א יוֹסֵ֔ף עַד־ שְׁנֵ֖י דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: yō·wm ḥō·šeḵ wa·’ă·p̄ê·lāh yō·wm ‘ā·nān wa·‘ă·rā·p̄el kə·ša·ḥar pā·ruś ‘al- he·hā·rîm ‘am raḇ wə·‘ā·ṣūm kā·mō·hū lō nih·yāh min- hā·‘ō·w·lām wə·’a·ḥă·rāw lō yō·w·sêp̄ ‘aḏ- šə·nê dō·wr wā·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: a day of darkness and gloom a day of clouds and blackness Like the dawn overspreading . . . the mountains a great and strong army appears such as never was of old nor will ever be . . . . . . in ages to come . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Dia de trevas e de escuridão; dia de nuvens e densas trevas, como a alva espalhada sobre os montes; povo grande e poderoso, qual nunca houve desde o tempo antigo, nem depois dele haverá pelos anos adiante, de geração em geração.

verses.original: לְפָנָיו֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֵ֔שׁ וְאַחֲרָ֖יו תְּלַהֵ֣ט לֶֽהָבָ֑ה כְּגַן־ עֵ֨דֶן הָאָ֜רֶץ לְפָנָ֗יו וְאַֽחֲרָיו֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְגַם־ פְּלֵיטָ֖ה לֹא־ הָ֥יְתָה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·p̄ā·nāw ’ā·ḵə·lāh ’êš wə·’a·ḥă·rāw tə·la·hêṭ le·hā·ḇāh kə·ḡan- ‘ê·ḏen hā·’ā·reṣ lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·’a·ḥă·rāw miḏ·bar šə·mā·māh wə·ḡam- pə·lê·ṭāh lō- hā·yə·ṯāh lōw
verses.literal: Before them a fire devours and behind them a flame scorches The land before them is like the Garden of Eden but behind them it is like a desert wasteland surely nothing will escape them
verses.literalPt: Diante dele um fogo consome, e atrás dele uma chama abrasa; a terra diante dele é como o jardim do Éden, mas atrás dele um desolado deserto; sim, nada lhe escapará.

verses.original: כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה סוּסִ֖ים מַרְאֵ֑הוּ וּכְפָרָשִׁ֖ים כֵּ֥ן יְרוּצֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mar·’êh sū·sîm mar·’ê·hū ū·ḵə·p̄ā·rā·šîm kên yə·rū·ṣūn
verses.literal: Their appearance is like that of horses and they gallop like swift steeds . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua aparência é como a de cavalos; e como cavaleiros assim correm.

verses.original: כְּק֣וֹל מַרְכָּב֗וֹת עַל־ רָאשֵׁ֤י הֶֽהָרִים֙ יְרַקֵּד֔וּן כְּקוֹל֙ לַ֣הַב אֵ֔שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה קָ֑שׁ כְּעַ֣ם עָצ֔וּם עֱר֖וּךְ מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kə·qō·wl mar·kā·ḇō·wṯ ‘al- rā·šê he·hā·rîm yə·raq·qê·ḏūn kə·qō·wl la·haḇ ’êš ’ō·ḵə·lāh qāš kə·‘am ‘ā·ṣūm ‘ĕ·rūḵ mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: With a sound like that of chariots they bound over the mountaintops like the crackling of fire . . . consuming stubble like a mighty army deployed for battle
verses.literalPt: Como o estrondo de carros, irão saltando sobre os cumes dos montes, como o ruído da chama de fogo que consome a pragana, como um povo poderoso, posto em ordem para o combate.

verses.original: מִפָּנָ֖יו יָחִ֣ילוּ עַמִּ֑ים כָּל־ פָּנִ֖ים קִבְּצ֥וּ פָארֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: mip·pā·nāw yā·ḥî·lū ‘am·mîm kāl- pā·nîm qib·bə·ṣū p̄ā·rūr
verses.literal: Nations writhe in horror before them every face turns pale . . .
verses.literalPt: Diante dele temerão os povos; todos os rostos se tornarão enegrecidos.

verses.original: כְּגִבּוֹרִ֣ים יְרֻצ֔וּן כְּאַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה יַעֲל֣וּ חוֹמָ֑ה וְאִ֤ישׁ בִּדְרָכָיו֙ יֵֽלֵכ֔וּן וְלֹ֥א יְעַבְּט֖וּן אֹרְחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḡib·bō·w·rîm yə·ru·ṣūn kə·’an·šê mil·ḥā·māh ya·‘ă·lū ḥō·w·māh wə·’îš biḏ·rā·ḵāw yê·lê·ḵūn wə·lō yə·‘ab·bə·ṭūn ’ō·rə·ḥō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: They charge like mighty men they scale the walls like men of war Each one marches in formation not swerving from the course
verses.literalPt: Como valentes correrão, como homens de guerra subirão os muros; e marchará cada um no seu caminho e não se desviará da sua fileira.

verses.original: וְאִ֤ישׁ אָחִיו֙ לֹ֣א יִדְחָק֔וּן גֶּ֥בֶר בִּמְסִלָּת֖וֹ יֵֽלֵכ֑וּן וּבְעַ֥ד הַשֶּׁ֛לַח יִפֹּ֖לוּ לֹ֥א יִבְצָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ā·ḥîw lō yiḏ·ḥā·qūn ge·ḇer bim·sil·lā·ṯōw yê·lê·ḵūn ū·ḇə·‘aḏ haš·še·laḥ yip·pō·lū lō yiḇ·ṣā·‘ū
verses.literal: They do not jostle one another each proceeds . . . in his path They burst through the defenses never breaking ranks
verses.literalPt: Ninguém apertará a seu irmão; marchará cada um pelo seu caminho; sobre a mesma espada se arremessarão, e não serão feridos.

verses.original: בָּעִ֣יר יָשֹׁ֗קּוּ בַּֽחוֹמָה֙ יְרֻצ֔וּן בַּבָּתִּ֖ים יַעֲל֑וּ בְּעַ֧ד הַחַלּוֹנִ֛ים יָבֹ֖אוּ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: bā·‘îr yā·šōq·qū ba·ḥō·w·māh yə·ru·ṣūn bab·bāt·tîm ya·‘ă·lū bə·‘aḏ ha·ḥal·lō·w·nîm yā·ḇō·’ū kag·gan·nāḇ
verses.literal: They storm the city they run along the wall they climb into houses entering through windows like thieves
verses.literalPt: Irão pela cidade, correrão pelos muros, subirão às casas, entrarão pelas janelas como o ladrão.

verses.original: לְפָנָיו֙ רָ֣גְזָה אֶ֔רֶץ רָעֲשׁ֖וּ שָׁמָ֑יִם שֶׁ֤מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֙חַ֙ קָדָ֔רוּ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים אָסְפ֥וּ נָגְהָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·p̄ā·nāw rā·ḡə·zāh ’e·reṣ rā·‘ă·šū šā·mā·yim še·meš wə·yā·rê·aḥ qā·ḏā·rū wə·ḵō·w·ḵā·ḇîm ’ā·sə·p̄ū nā·ḡə·hām
verses.literal: Before them the earth quakes the heavens tremble The sun and moon grow dark and the stars lose their brightness
verses.literalPt: Diante dele tremerá a terra, abalar-se-ão os céus; o sol e a lua se enegrecerão, e as estrelas retirarão o seu resplendor.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן קוֹלוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י חֵיל֔וֹ כִּ֣י רַ֤ב מְאֹד֙ מַחֲנֵ֔הוּ כִּ֥י עָצ֖וּם עֹשֵׂ֣ה דְבָר֑וֹ כִּֽי־ גָד֧וֹל יוֹם־ יְהוָ֛ה וְנוֹרָ֥א מְאֹ֖ד וּמִ֥י יְכִילֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh nā·ṯan qō·w·lōw lip̄·nê ḥê·lōw kî raḇ mə·’ōḏ ma·ḥă·nê·hū kî ‘ā·ṣūm ‘ō·śêh ḏə·ḇā·rōw kî- ḡā·ḏō·wl yō·wm- Yah·weh wə·nō·w·rā mə·’ōḏ ū·mî yə·ḵî·len·nū
verses.literal: The LORD raises His voice in the presence of His army Indeed His camp is very large for mighty are those who obey His command For the Day of the LORD is great and very dreadful Who can endure it
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR levantará a sua voz diante do seu exército; porque muitíssimo grande é o seu arraial; porque poderoso é, executando a sua palavra; porque o dia do SENHOR é grande e mui terrível, e quem o poderá suportar?

verses.original: וְגַם־ עַתָּה֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה שֻׁ֥בוּ עָדַ֖י בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וּבְצ֥וֹם וּבְבְכִ֖י וּבְמִסְפֵּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ‘at·tāh nə·’um- Yah·weh šu·ḇū ‘ā·ḏay bə·ḵāl lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem ū·ḇə·ṣō·wm ū·ḇə·ḇə·ḵī ū·ḇə·mis·pêḏ
verses.literal: Yet even now declares the LORD return to Me with all your heart with fasting weeping and mourning
verses.literalPt: Ainda assim, agora mesmo diz o SENHOR: Convertei-vos a mim de todo o vosso coração; e isso com jejuns, e com choro, e com pranto.

verses.original: וְקִרְע֤וּ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַל־ בִּגְדֵיכֶ֔ם וְשׁ֖וּבוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ חַנּ֤וּן וְרַחוּם֙ ה֔וּא אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֙יִם֙ וְרַב־ חֶ֔סֶד וְנִחָ֖ם עַל־ הָרָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qir·‘ū lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem wə·’al- biḡ·ḏê·ḵem wə·šū·ḇū ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem kî- ḥan·nūn wə·ra·ḥūm hū ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim wə·raḇ- ḥe·seḏ wə·ni·ḥām ‘al- hā·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: So rend your hearts and not your garments and return to the LORD your God For He is gracious and compassionate slow to anger abounding in loving devotion And He relents from sending disaster
verses.literalPt: E rasgai o vosso coração, e não as vossas vestes, e convertei-vos ao SENHOR vosso Deus; porque ele é misericordioso, e compassivo, e tardio em irar-se, e grande em benignidade, e se arrepende do mal.

verses.original: מִ֥י יוֹדֵ֖עַ יָשׁ֣וּב וְנִחָ֑ם וְהִשְׁאִ֤יר אַֽחֲרָיו֙ בְּרָכָ֔ה מִנְחָ֣ה וָנֶ֔סֶךְ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: mî yō·w·ḏê·a‘ yā·šūḇ wə·ni·ḥām wə·hiš·’îr ’a·ḥă·rāw bə·rā·ḵāh min·ḥāh wā·ne·seḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Who knows He may turn and relent and leave a blessing behind Him grain and drink offerings for the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Quem sabe se não se voltará e se arrependerá, e deixará após si uma bênção, em oferta de alimentos e libação para o SENHOR vosso Deus?

verses.original: תִּקְע֥וּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּצִיּ֑וֹן קַדְּשׁוּ־ צ֖וֹם קִרְא֥וּ עֲצָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tiq·‘ū šō·w·p̄ār bə·ṣî·yō·wn qad·də·šū- ṣō·wm qir·’ū ‘ă·ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion consecrate a fast proclaim a sacred assembly
verses.literalPt: Tocai a trombeta em Sião, santificai um jejum, convocai uma assembléia solene.

verses.original: אִסְפוּ־ עָ֞ם קַדְּשׁ֤וּ קָהָל֙ קִבְצ֣וּ זְקֵנִ֔ים אִסְפוּ֙ עֽוֹלָלִ֔ים וְיֹנְקֵ֖י שָׁדָ֑יִם יֵצֵ֤א חָתָן֙ מֵֽחֶדְר֔וֹ וְכַלָּ֖ה מֵחֻפָּתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’is·p̄ū- ‘ām qad·də·šū qā·hāl qiḇ·ṣū zə·qê·nîm ’is·p̄ū ‘ō·w·lā·lîm wə·yō·nə·qê šā·ḏā·yim yê·ṣê ḥā·ṯān mê·ḥeḏ·rōw wə·ḵal·lāh mê·ḥup·pā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Gather the people sanctify the congregation assemble the aged gather the children even those nursing at the breast Let the bridegroom leave his room and the bride her chamber
verses.literalPt: Congregai o povo, santificai a congregação, ajuntai os anciãos, congregai as crianças, e os que mamam; saia o noivo da sua recâmara, e a noiva do seu aposento.

verses.original: בֵּ֤ין הָאוּלָם֙ וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ יִבְכּוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְֽיֹאמְר֞וּ ח֧וּסָה יְהוָ֣ה עַל־ עַמֶּ֗ךָ וְאַל־ תִּתֵּ֨ן נַחֲלָתְךָ֤ לְחֶרְפָּה֙ לִמְשָׁל־ בָּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם לָ֚מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ בָֽעַמִּ֔ים אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bên hā·’ū·lām wə·lam·miz·bê·aḥ yiḇ·kū hak·kō·hă·nîm mə·šā·rə·ṯê Yah·weh wə·yō·mə·rū ḥū·sāh Yah·weh ‘al- ‘am·me·ḵā wə·’al- tit·tên na·ḥă·lā·ṯə·ḵā lə·ḥer·pāh lim·šāl- bām gō·w·yim lām·māh yō·mə·rū ḇā·‘am·mîm ’ay·yêh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: Let the priests who minister before the LORD weep between the portico and the altar saying Spare Your people O LORD and do not make Your heritage a reproach an object of scorn among the nations Why should they say among the peoples Where is their God
verses.literalPt: Chorem os sacerdotes, ministros do SENHOR, entre o alpendre e o altar, e digam: Poupa a teu povo, ó SENHOR, e não entregues a tua herança ao opróbrio, para que os gentios o dominem; porque diriam entre os povos: Onde está o seu Deus?

verses.original: וַיְקַנֵּ֥א יְהוָ֖ה לְאַרְצ֑וֹ וַיַּחְמֹ֖ל עַל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·qan·nê Yah·weh lə·’ar·ṣōw way·yaḥ·mōl ‘al- ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: Then the LORD became jealous for His land and He spared . . . His people
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR se mostrou zeloso da sua terra, e compadeceu-se do seu povo.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעַמּ֗וֹ הִנְנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֤חַ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־ הַדָּגָן֙ וְהַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֔ר וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֖ם אֹת֑וֹ וְלֹא־ אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְכֶ֥ם ע֛וֹד חֶרְפָּ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an Yah·weh way·yō·mer lə·‘am·mōw hin·nî šō·lê·aḥ lā·ḵem ’eṯ- had·dā·ḡān wə·hat·tî·rō·wōš wə·hay·yiṣ·hār ū·śə·ḇa‘·tem ’ō·ṯōw wə·lō- ’et·tên ’eṯ·ḵem ‘ō·wḏ ḥer·pāh bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: And the LORD . . . answered His people Behold I will send you grain new wine and oil and by them you will be satisfied I will never again . . . make you a reproach among the nations
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR, respondendo, disse ao seu povo: Eis que vos envio o trigo, e o mosto, e o azeite, e deles sereis fartos, e vos não entregarei mais ao opróbrio entre os gentios.

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ הַצְּפוֹנִ֞י אַרְחִ֣יק מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִדַּחְתִּיו֮ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֣ה וּשְׁמָמָה֒ אֶת־ פָּנָ֗יו אֶל־ הַיָּם֙ הַקַּדְמֹנִ֔י וְסֹפ֖וֹ אֶל־ הַיָּ֣ם הָאַֽחֲר֑וֹן וְעָלָ֣ה בָאְשׁ֗וֹ וְתַ֙עַל֙ צַחֲנָת֔וֹ כִּ֥י הִגְדִּ֖יל לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- haṣ·ṣə·p̄ō·w·nî ’ar·ḥîq mê·‘ă·lê·ḵem wə·hid·daḥ·tîw ’el- ’e·reṣ ṣî·yāh ū·šə·mā·māh ’eṯ- pā·nāw ’el- hay·yām haq·qaḏ·mō·nî wə·sō·p̄ōw ’el- hay·yām hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn wə·‘ā·lāh ḇā·’ə·šōw wə·ṯa·‘al ṣa·ḥă·nā·ṯōw kî hiḡ·dîl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: The northern army I will drive away from you banishing it to a barren and desolate land its front ranks into the Eastern Sea and its rear guard into the Western Sea And its stench will rise its foul odor will ascend For He has done great things
verses.literalPt: Mas removerei para longe de vós o exército do norte, e lançá-lo-ei em uma terra seca e deserta; a sua frente para o mar oriental, e a sua retaguarda para o mar ocidental; e subirá o seu mau cheiro, e subirá a sua podridão; porque fez grandes coisas.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽירְאִ֖י אֲדָמָ֑ה גִּ֣ילִי וּשְׂמָ֔חִי כִּֽי־ הִגְדִּ֥יל יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rə·’î ’ă·ḏā·māh gî·lî ū·śə·mā·ḥî kî- hiḡ·dîl Yah·weh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: Do not be afraid O land rejoice and be glad for the LORD has done great things
verses.literalPt: Não temas, ó terra: regozija-te e alegra-te, porque o SENHOR fez grandes coisas.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽירְאוּ֙ בַּהֲמ֣וֹת שָׂדַ֔י כִּ֥י דָשְׁא֖וּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר כִּֽי־ עֵץ֙ נָשָׂ֣א פִרְי֔וֹ תְּאֵנָ֥ה וָגֶ֖פֶן נָתְנ֥וּ חֵילָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rə·’ū ba·hă·mō·wṯ śā·ḏay kî ḏā·šə·’ū nə·’ō·wṯ miḏ·bār kî- ‘êṣ nā·śā p̄ir·yōw tə·’ê·nāh wā·ḡe·p̄en nā·ṯə·nū ḥê·lām
verses.literal: Do not be afraid O beasts of the field for the open pastures have turned green the trees bear their fruit and the fig tree and vine yield their best
verses.literalPt: Não temais, animais do campo, porque os pastos do deserto reverdecerão, porque o arvoredo dará o seu fruto, a vide e a figueira darão a sua força.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן גִּ֤ילוּ וְשִׂמְחוּ֙ בַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ נָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם אֶת־ הַמּוֹרֶ֖ה לִצְדָקָ֑ה וַיּ֣וֹרֶד לָכֶ֗ם גֶּ֛שֶׁם מוֹרֶ֥ה וּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ בָּרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ṣî·yō·wn gî·lū wə·śim·ḥū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem kî- nā·ṯan lā·ḵem ’eṯ- ham·mō·w·reh liṣ·ḏā·qāh way·yō·w·reḏ lā·ḵem ge·šem mō·w·reh ū·mal·qō·wōš bā·ri·šō·wn
verses.literal: Be glad O children of Zion and rejoice in the LORD your God for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication He sends you showers both autumn and spring rains as before
verses.literalPt: E vós, filhos de Sião, regozijai-vos e alegrai-vos no SENHOR vosso Deus, porque ele vos dará em justa medida a chuva temporã; fará descer a chuva no primeiro mês, a temporã e a serôdia.

verses.original: וּמָלְא֥וּ הַגֳּרָנ֖וֹת בָּ֑ר וְהֵשִׁ֥יקוּ הַיְקָבִ֖ים תִּיר֥וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·lə·’ū hag·go·rā·nō·wṯ bār wə·hê·šî·qū hay·qā·ḇîm tî·rō·wōš wə·yiṣ·hār
verses.literal: The threshing floors will be full of grain and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil
verses.literalPt: E as eiras se encherão de trigo, e os lagares transbordarão de mosto e de azeite.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֙ אָכַ֣ל הָֽאַרְבֶּ֔ה הַיֶּ֖לֶק וְהֶחָסִ֣יל וְהַגָּזָ֑ם חֵילִי֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁלַּ֖חְתִּי בָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·lam·tî lā·ḵem ’eṯ- haš·šā·nîm ’ă·šer ’ā·ḵal hā·’ar·beh hay·ye·leq wə·he·ḥā·sîl wə·hag·gā·zām ḥê·lî hag·gā·ḏō·wl ’ă·šer šil·laḥ·tî bā·ḵem
verses.literal: I will repay you for the years eaten by locusts the swarming locust the young locust the destroying locust and the devouring locust My great army that I sent against you
verses.literalPt: E restituir-vos-ei os anos que comeu o gafanhoto, a locusta, e o pulgão e a lagarta, o meu grande exército que enviei contra vós.

verses.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אָכוֹל֙ וְשָׂב֔וֹעַ וְהִלַּלְתֶּ֗ם אֶת־ שֵׁ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה עִמָּכֶ֖ם לְהַפְלִ֑יא וְלֹא־ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḵal·tem ’ā·ḵō·wl wə·śā·ḇō·w·a‘ wə·hil·lal·tem ’eṯ- šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ‘im·mā·ḵem lə·hap̄·lî wə·lō- yê·ḇō·šū ‘am·mî lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: You will have plenty to eat . . . until you are satisfied You will praise the name of the LORD your God who has worked wonders for you My people will never again . . . be put to shame
verses.literalPt: E comereis abundantemente e vos fartareis, e louvareis o nome do SENHOR vosso Deus, que procedeu para convosco maravilhosamente; e o meu povo nunca mais será envergonhado.

verses.original: וִידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י בְקֶ֤רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אָ֔נִי וַאֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין ע֑וֹד וְלֹא־ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wî·ḏa‘·tem kî ḇə·qe·reḇ yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·nî wa·’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ wə·lō- yê·ḇō·šū ‘am·mî lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Then you will know that I am present in Israel and that I am the LORD your God and there is no other My people will never again . . . be put to shame
verses.literalPt: E vós sabereis que eu estou no meio de Israel, e que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, e que não há outro; e o meu povo nunca mais será envergonhado.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁפּ֤וֹךְ אֶת־ רוּחִי֙ עַל־ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֔ר וְנִבְּא֖וּ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם זִקְנֵיכֶם֙ חֲלֹמ֣וֹת יַחֲלֹמ֔וּן בַּח֣וּרֵיכֶ֔ם חֶזְיֹנ֖וֹת יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên ’eš·pō·wḵ ’eṯ- rū·ḥî ‘al- kāl- bā·śār wə·nib·bə·’ū bə·nê·ḵem ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem ziq·nê·ḵem ḥă·lō·mō·wṯ ya·ḥă·lō·mūn ba·ḥū·rê·ḵem ḥez·yō·nō·wṯ yir·’ū
verses.literal: And afterward . . . I will pour out My Spirit on all people Your sons and daughters will prophesy your old men will dream dreams . . . your young men will see visions
verses.literalPt: E há de ser que, depois derramarei o meu Espírito sobre toda a carne, e vossos filhos e vossas filhas profetizarão, os vossos velhos terão sonhos, os vossos jovens terão visões.

verses.original: וְגַ֥ם עַל־ הָֽעֲבָדִ֖ים וְעַל־ הַשְּׁפָח֑וֹת בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔מָּה אֶשְׁפּ֖וֹךְ אֶת־ רוּחִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ‘al- hā·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wə·‘al- haš·šə·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm·māh ’eš·pō·wḵ ’eṯ- rū·ḥî
verses.literal: Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days
verses.literalPt: E também sobre os servos e sobre as servas naqueles dias derramarei o meu Espírito.

verses.original: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ מֽוֹפְתִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ דָּ֣ם וָאֵ֔שׁ וְתִֽימֲר֖וֹת עָשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî mō·wp̄·ṯîm baš·šā·ma·yim ū·ḇā·’ā·reṣ dām wā·’êš wə·ṯî·mă·rō·wṯ ‘ā·šān
verses.literal: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth blood and fire and columns of smoke
verses.literalPt: E mostrarei prodígios no céu, e na terra, sangue e fogo, e colunas de fumaça.

verses.original: הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ יֵהָפֵ֣ךְ לְחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהַיָּרֵ֖חַ לְדָ֑ם לִפְנֵ֗י בּ֚וֹא י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה הַגָּד֖וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: haš·še·meš yê·hā·p̄êḵ lə·ḥō·šeḵ wə·hay·yā·rê·aḥ lə·ḏām lip̄·nê bō·w yō·wm Yah·weh hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·han·nō·w·rā
verses.literal: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD
verses.literalPt: O sol se converterá em trevas, e a lua em sangue, antes que venha o grande e terrível dia do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כֹּ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָ֛א בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה יִמָּלֵ֑ט כִּ֠י בְּהַר־ צִיּ֨וֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה פְלֵיטָ֗ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וּבַ֨שְּׂרִידִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה קֹרֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kōl ’ă·šer- yiq·rā bə·šêm Yah·weh yim·mā·lêṭ kî bə·har- ṣî·yō·wn ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim tih·yeh p̄ə·lê·ṭāh ka·’ă·šer ’ā·mar Yah·weh ū·ḇaś·śə·rî·ḏîm ’ă·šer Yah·weh qō·rê
verses.literal: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance as the LORD has promised among the remnant called by the LORD
verses.literalPt: E há de ser que todo aquele que invocar o nome do SENHOR será salvo; porque no monte Sião e em Jerusalém haverá livramento, assim como disse o SENHOR, e entre os sobreviventes, aqueles que o SENHOR chamar.
